articles.title: Scientists reveal the hidden danger of missing blood pressure medication
articles.originalTitle: Scientists reveal the hidden danger of missing blood pressure medication
articles.excerpt: Missing blood pressure medication could mean losing much of its protection against heart attacks and strokes, according to an analysis of more than 91,000 people. Patients who consistently took their medication experienced an 11% reduction in major cardiovascular events, while those who missed too many doses saw little or no measurable benefit.

articles.title: Three giant black holes discovered in a galaxy from the dawn of time
articles.originalTitle: Three giant black holes discovered in a galaxy from the dawn of time
articles.excerpt: Astronomers have discovered three actively feeding black holes inside a single galaxy more than 12.5 billion light-years away, revealing a remarkable scene from the universe’s infancy. Two of the black holes are separated by just 620 light-years and are expected to eventually merge, while a third lurks farther away. One weighs an astonishing 80 million suns, and another is growing faster than conventional theories predict.

articles.title: New evidence suggests spinosaurus spent most of its life underwater
articles.originalTitle: New evidence suggests spinosaurus spent most of its life underwater
articles.excerpt: Millions of years after animals first conquered land, some took an extraordinary evolutionary U-turn and returned to the water. Using machine learning and thousands of fossil measurements, Yale scientists have uncovered surprising clues about which prehistoric creatures truly became aquatic. Their findings suggest that Spinosaurus spent most of its life underwater, while some ancient marine reptiles previously thought to be fully aquatic actually spent considerable time on land.
